title: Asteria — AI launch-page builder
description: A light, single-accent landing page for an AI tool that turns a one-sentence product idea into a launch page. The hero lets visitors type or pick an idea and watch a real page assemble block by block, followed by a pinned how-it-works story, a notes-versus-draft comparison, publish and export flows, and odometer pricing.
features: Type an idea and watch a launch page assemble stage by stage
Deterministic drafts from typed ideas, with guessed lines flagged
Tone-of-voice picker that rewrites the sample headline
Fan-out brand palette with click-to-copy hex
Design-tool scrub fields on a live mini hero
Publish button that becomes its own progress bar
Reduced-motion aware, keyboard accessible, no horizontal scroll at 390px
